name: kitchensink4web-dev
description: Field-test build of the KitchenSink4Web browser MCP server: same code as the shipped bundle, different install-screen defaults. Beta field-test build: every capability is switched on. The shipped product installs read-only.
long_description: This is the field-test build. It runs exactly the same server as the shipped bundle and differs only in what the install screen starts with: the cookies-and-logins pack is already on, because saving and reloading a login is what field tests spend their time on. Everything the shipped bundle refuses to do by default, this build still refuses: acting stays off until you turn it on, and the safety layer is the same one. Launching this bundle requires uv (the uvx command) on your machine; the server itself is fetched from PyPI on first launch. Use the shipped bundle for anything that is not a test.

allow_acting.title: Allow this server to click and type
allow_acting.description: Lets Claude click buttons, type into forms, and submit pages; leave it off and Claude can only read and navigate, with nothing on the page changeable.

all_packs.title: Load every capability pack
all_packs.description: Turns on all seven packs below at once instead of choosing them one by one.

pack_extract.title: Data extraction
pack_extract.description: Pulls structured data off pages: tables, lists, links, and page details, with CSV and JSON export, and reads long documents page by page so one read never floods the conversation.

pack_capture.title: Screenshots and page capture
pack_capture.description: Takes screenshots (passwords masked) and saves pages as PDF or archive files.

pack_network.title: Network inspection
pack_network.description: Shows the page's network requests and responses, and lets Claude block or mock them for testing.

pack_storage.title: Cookies and logins
pack_storage.description: Works with cookies and site storage, and saves a signed-in session to a file so it can be reused next time. It saves the session, never the password. On in this build, because a field test that cannot save a session spends its first hour signing in.

pack_files.title: Downloads and uploads
pack_files.description: Downloads files from pages into one dedicated folder, fetches a file by URL through the same checks, uploads files into page forms, and reads or writes the clipboard, with every write stopping to ask first.

pack_diagnostics.title: Page diagnostics
pack_diagnostics.description: Reads the page's own error messages and console output, and can run a page script only after you confirm it.

pack_workflows.title: Recorded workflows
pack_workflows.description: Records a multi-step flow once and replays it later, checking every step still matches the page before anything runs.

pack_accessibility.title: Accessibility audit
pack_accessibility.description: Checks a page against the WCAG accessibility rules using axe-core, groups what it finds by rule, and says plainly what automated testing cannot check.

consent_scope.title: What Claude may do without asking
consent_scope.description: Type research or full. Only applies when "Allow this server to click and type" is on; leave it as research if you are unsure. [COPY PENDING: manifest.consent_scope | CAUTION tier] FACTS TO CONVEY: this sets how often Claude stops to ask you. research, the default, pre-approves reading, navigating, clicking, typing, and search-shaped form submission, and asks before anything else. full also pre-approves ordinary form submission. Neither one touches the actions that always stop and ask a human: paying, submitting a credential, sending something that reaches other people, deleting, accepting terms, and passing an age gate. It does nothing at all while acting is off, because there is nothing to consent to. This is a typed field and a value that is not one of the two words stops the server from starting, with the two words named.

preauth.title: Pre-authorized actions (advanced, leave empty)
preauth.description: Optional. Pre-approves one class of action on one site, so Claude stops asking about it. Format: class@site, for example storage_load@github.com. [COPY PENDING: manifest.preauth | CAUTION tier] FACTS TO CONVEY: empty is the normal setting and means every gate asks. One entry pre-approves ONE action class on ONE site named here, for this install, until you change it; separate several with commas and add :8h to give one a time limit. Paying, submitting a credential, sending something that reaches other people, deleting, accepting terms, acting off an allowlist, and resetting budgets can NEVER be pre-authorized, and naming one of them here stops the server from starting rather than quietly ignoring it. Like the box above, this is a typed field: a misspelling stops the server from starting and says what the format is.
